jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603 inventory: Stannard Town School District, a town school district in the Orleans Southwest Supervisory Union (member town: Stannard), distinct from the Mountain View Union Elementary district (which serves Stannard's PK-6 students). Non-operating: the district governs tuition funding for grades 7-12.

board.post_note: Stannard Town SD: three directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a), one 3-year seat elected each year.

sources.note: Orleans Southwest SU "Stannard School Board Members" roster (official, linked from the SU's Stannard board page; fetched 2026-10-22): Kurdek (Chair) 2028, Cohen (Vice Chair) 2029, Janukajtis (Clerk) 2027 -- each seat a 3-year term on the statutory stagger. Corroborated by the SU superintendent's spring 2026 newsletter listing the same three and noting the SU's boards "everyone returned" (no March 2026 turnover). (The newsletter calls Cohen "(Chair)" against the roster's Kurdek -- roles are not modeled.) No Stannard warning or certified return was fetched; resolving document: the 2026 town report / annual meeting records (Town Clerk, Stannard).
